target_lang_translations.fr: La rosée du matin <w>perlait</w> sur la toile d'araignée, captant la lumière du soleil levant.

target_lang_definitions.tr: İnci şekline benzer küçük, yuvarlak damlalar oluşturmak.

senses.sense_definition: To dive or search for pearls in the ocean.

examples.text: The men went <w>pearling</w> in the deep waters of the bay to support their families.
